description: Figure 8 is a grouped bar chart illustrating the performance of three different audio-language models—Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni—on two evaluation benchmarks: MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR. The vertical y-axis represents “Accuracy (%)” and ranges from 0 to 70, with major tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal x-axis lists the three models as categorical groups. Within each group, two bars are displayed side-by-side: a blue bar representing MMAU performance and a purple bar representing MMAR performance, as indicated by the legend in the top-left corner. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the MMAU accuracy is approximately 49%, while MMAR is around 30%. For Audio-Reasoner, MMAU accuracy is approximately 62%, and MMAR is around 37%. For Qwen-2.5-Omni, MMAU accuracy reaches approximately 66%, and MMAR is around 57%. The chart visually demonstrates that for all three models, performance on MMAU is higher than on MMAR, and Qwen-2.5-Omni achieves the highest scores on both benchmarks.
